description: Hydropower Impact_River Flow_Sweden is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Berit Arheimer (Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute). River flow (m 3 yr -1 ) for 12 selected hydropower plants in Swedish rivers as well as the total river discharge to the Swedish coast. Coverage: national (SE); the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
